caseStudies.title: Reality Check - Explainable Manipulation Risk Platform
caseStudies.challenge: Teams needed a scalable and explainable way to identify manipulation patterns in high-volume digital text.
approach: Designed a hybrid scoring engine combining rule-based checks with transformer-based contextual analysis.
Built a React and FastAPI review interface that shows supporting rationale for each risk category.
Added confidence scoring and exportable reports to support review workflows.
outcome: Reduced review effort through prioritized risk queues.
Improved confidence in decisions with explainable evidence trails.
Made reporting easier for recurring review and documentation needs.

caseStudies.title: MediCore - End-to-End Hospital Workflow Platform
caseStudies.challenge: Healthcare operations were spread across disconnected systems for appointments, billing, and telehealth.
approach: Designed a role-based MERN architecture for admins, staff, and practitioners.
Implemented appointment management, billing modules, and telehealth workflows in one interface.
Added JWT authentication, alerts, and dashboard metrics for day-to-day visibility.
outcome: Unified key clinical workflows in a single platform.
Improved response speed through notification-driven operations.
Provided dashboards for clearer operational decision-making.

caseStudies.title: Veluxe Motors - Digital Showroom Experience
caseStudies.challenge: The dealership needed a stronger digital presence with a clearer inquiry flow for potential customers.
approach: Built a Next.js frontend focused on fast rendering and smooth browsing.
Created dynamic listing sections and inquiry paths to support product discovery.
Structured the interface with clear hierarchy and mobile-friendly behavior.
outcome: Improved clarity in the inquiry journey for prospective buyers.
Created a more structured browsing experience across listings.
Established a frontend foundation that can be extended over time.

caseStudies.title: Crop Yield Prediction in Pakistan - Regional Forecasting Project
caseStudies.challenge: Agricultural planning required more reliable yield insights across different regions and historical conditions.
approach: Prepared multi-region historical datasets with robust preprocessing and feature engineering.
Trained and benchmarked multiple ML models to compare predictive reliability.
Built interpretable visual outputs to support planning decisions.
outcome: Delivered clearer regional yield trend visibility.
Improved decision confidence with interpretable analytics.

caseStudies.title: Employment and Unemployment Trend Analysis
caseStudies.challenge: The project aimed to explain long-term labor trends, COVID-era impacts, and seasonal shifts more clearly.
approach: Integrated and cleaned multi-source labor datasets with robust date and missing-value handling.
Built comparative analytics for pre- and post-COVID periods and seasonal fluctuations.
Designed visuals that make trend interpretation easier for non-technical audiences.
outcome: Provided reliable labor trend analysis across multiple time windows.
Highlighted monthly volatility and structural shifts in employment behavior.
Improved communication of economic signals through concise visual storytelling.

blogPosts.title: Building Reality Check: Explainable AI for Manipulation Risk
blogPosts.excerpt: How hybrid NLP scoring and transparent rationale made risk signals usable for policy and media teams.
content: Reality Check started from a practical challenge: risk scoring must be explainable, not only accurate.
A hybrid approach combining deterministic checks with transformer context created stronger trust in predictions.
The biggest product lesson was designing explanation output as a core feature, not a post-processing add-on.

blogPosts.title: MediCore: Building Role-Based Healthcare Workflows
blogPosts.excerpt: How appointments, billing, and telehealth were brought together in one operational platform.
content: Healthcare systems fail when operational modules are disconnected and user roles are unclear.
MediCore focused on role-based pathways to reduce friction in everyday hospital operations.
Security and notification flows were treated as first-class requirements from day one.

blogPosts.title: Designing Veluxe Motors: Dealership UX That Supports Inquiry
blogPosts.excerpt: How interface structure and frontend decisions improved the dealership inquiry journey.
content: Automotive websites should not only look polished; they should make browsing and inquiry easier.
Veluxe Motors used clear visual hierarchy, structured content sections, and visible inquiry actions.
Performance and clarity both mattered because the experience needed to feel smooth on real devices.

blogPosts.title: Crop Yield Forecasting in Pakistan with Practical ML
blogPosts.excerpt: From regional data cleaning to model benchmarking and interpretable agricultural insight.
content: Agricultural forecasting depends heavily on data preparation quality and regional context handling.
Model comparison was used to balance predictive quality with operational interpretability.
Visual storytelling helped translate model outputs into practical planning insight.

blogPosts.title: Labor Trend Intelligence: Employment Analysis at Scale
blogPosts.excerpt: A practical method for communicating post-COVID and seasonal employment behavior clearly.
content: Labor trend analysis becomes useful when patterns are compared across structural time windows.
This project prioritized clarity in visual communication for non-technical decision makers.
Reliable cleaning and temporal consistency were central to trustworthy trend interpretation.
